ratios.label: Earnings per share
ratios.withheld_reason: Withheld: the audit in _calc_coverage.json flags this value as computed from a wrong input (a share count or a profit filed in different units). A blank is honest; a ratio built on a wrong input is not a valuation.

valuation.note: loss-making in the latest period, so P/E is not meaningful
valuation.pe_withheld_reason: Withheld: the latest period reports no positive net profit, so a P/E is not defined; _calc_coverage.json flags an input to this security as suspect (eps); the EPS input is withheld. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
valuation.basis: current market cap vs latest reported period
valuation.periodNote: market price is a current snapshot; earnings are for FY2025
